review_summary.scope: fixed160 development records, final checkpoint-134 only
review_summary.review_type: agent semantic review, not independent human review
frozen_rule_limitations: pip题附加sys.executable核验，主命令正确但漏该项仍严格扣分。
退出状态题附加0成功含义，仅正确命令未必通过。
超时题未在问题中指定30秒，但固定规则要求30s；保留原规则并登记题规缺陷。
review_summary.truncation_policy: Length limit alone does not imply failure; reject actual errors/missing applicable facts.
review_summary.general_content_policy: Ignore wrappers/extra explanation only; correct named JSON fields inside an array still count as content but not format success. Contradictory/false extra claims fail content.
